source.title: The Emergency Food Assistance Program (TEFAP) Household Eligibility Criteria Form

questions.label: Distribution Agency Site Name
questions.note: The pantry's own name; not in the profile.

questions.label: Distribution Agency Site Address
questions.note: The pantry's address, not the applicant's.

questions.label: Income of the Household
questions.note: The applicant circles monthly or weekly beside it, so no single saved amount fits the blank.

questions.label: Monthly or Weekly (Circle One)
questions.note: The period of the income written beside it; the applicant's choice.

questions.label: Signature of Head of Household
questions.note: Self-attests income at or below the table and living in the area served.

questions.label: Authorized Representative: I hereby authorize ____ to pick up food for my household.
questions.note: Someone else who may pick up food; not in the profile.
